subject: Acme POC hands-on kickoff — proposed slot, runbook, and next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Hale <j.hale@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acme POC hands-on kickoff — proposed slot, runbook, and next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for agreeing to the hands-on POC with your infra and product teams. To get the most value out of the first session I propose a focused kickoff where we:

- Walk through the prompt set and expected routing behavior
- Run short connectivity checks and KV cache validation
- Execute a light load test (30–50 concurrent requests) with monitoring on latency/cost
- Agree on success criteria and next milestones

Proposed slot: Thursday June 11, 10:00–11:30 PT (90 minutes). If that doesn't work, we can pick alternate times next week. I've attached a short runbook and a pre-flight checklist for the engineers.

Prep items for your side:
- One engineer with infra access to oversee load tests
- A short list of 6–8 prompts we should validate
- Any IP/CIDR restrictions we should whitelist ahead of time

Attachments: Acme-POC-Runbook.pdf, Pre-flight-checklist.xlsx

Calendar link and shared drive with files here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-poc-resources

If the slot works I'll send an invite and a short agenda.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Hale <j.hale@acme-industries.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops+it@acme-industries.com
Date: 2026-06-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC hands-on kickoff — proposed slot, runbook, and next steps

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear plan and the runbook. Thursday 6/11 10:00–11:30 PT should work for most of us; I'm looping in ops+it for the infra side. We'll bring the prompt list by EOD Wednesday.

Two quick notes:
- Can we shorten to 60 minutes if we can't get the infra team to commit the whole 90?
- We're OK with the light load test but would like to keep request volume conservative to start.

I'll accept the invite once it's in calendar.

— Jordan
Jordan Hale
Director, Product Ops | Acme Industries
j.hale@acme-industries.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Hale <j.hale@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: Reminder: Acme POC kickoff today 10:00 PT — join link and quick agenda

Jordan / team —

Quick reminder about today's kickoff at 10:00 PT. If you need to drop to 60 minutes we can prioritize prompt review + routing checks and reserve load testing for a follow-up.

Join link: https://meet.redwoodinference.com/acme-poc-kickoff
Slack channel: #acme-poc (we'll watch there for infra updates)

Agenda (60 min fallback):
- 10:00–10:15 Intro + success criteria
- 10:15–10:35 Prompt review and routing expectations
- 10:35–10:55 Connectivity & KV cache checks
- 10:55–11:00 Next steps / follow-ups

If anything changes last-minute please ping me on Slack. Looking forward to it.

— Jonas
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Hale <j.hale@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Missed kickoff — checking in and next steps

Jordan —

We were on the call at 10:00 PT and didn't see anyone from Acme join. Sergio and I waited ~25 minutes and ran a couple of the connectivity checks on our side; logs looked clean and the demo prompts rendered as expected.

No worries if something came up — just want to confirm next steps so we don't lose momentum. Options:
- Reschedule a 60-minute restart focused on prompt review + routing (we'll skip load tests)
- Keep the original 90-minute plan but pick a new day when the infra lead can attend

If you prefer, send a few windows that work and we'll lock something in. I've reattached the runbook and checklist below.

Attachments: Acme-POC-Runbook.pdf (same), Pre-flight-checklist.xlsx

— Jonas
From: Jordan Hale <j.hale@acme-industries.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops+it@acme-industries.com
Date: 2026-06-12T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Missed kickoff — checking in and next steps

Jonas —

Really sorry about that. There was a calendar mix-up on our side and the infra lead was pulled into a customer incident at the last minute. I should have flagged it earlier — my apologies.

We appreciate you waiting and for the notes. Proposed alternative windows (all PT):
- Tue 6/16, 13:00–14:00
- Wed 6/17, 10:00–11:00

We'd prefer a 60-minute block to focus on the prompt set and routing; we can schedule load tests for a separate follow-up. Ops will be on both proposed windows for at least one engineer.

If either slot works for you and your team, I'll accept the calendar invite right away.

— Jordan
Jordan Hale
Director, Product Ops | Acme Industries
j.hale@acme-industries.com
